'''Black_wraith TAKE COVER!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 20 January 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kuat|SE-D-kuat.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Kuat
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Kuat Black wraith DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Kuat Drive Yards (V), Captain Lennox (V), Admiral Motti (V), Alert My Star Destroyer! (V), Imperial Domination (V), Imperial Decree (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

What's that in the sky? It's a bird……. No, it’s a plane……. wait a minute, those are bombers!!!!!!

== Notes ==

* Kuat and Kuat Drive Yards (v) appear under Starting and again under Systems / Effects; counted once (60).
* Original-era (V): Admiral Motti (V) (VS2); Captain Lennox (V) and Imperial Domination (V) (VS4); Alert My Star Destroyer! (V) (VS5); Kuat Drive Yards (V) and Imperial Decree (V) (VS6).
* Posted 'Secret plans' dested the Special Edition Effect, not the Reflections III shield (author: 'dont have a def v of secret').
* Posted 'Prep defenses' dested Prepared Defenses; 'Incon. Losses' Inconsequential Losses; 'SFS 9.3 Laser cann.' SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons; 'Scimitar Squad tie' Scimitar Squadron TIE.

== Strategy ==

Basically I get my bombers, bombs, and bombing runs out and about. The admiral’s orders there so when I fire my bombs my bombers are power +3.  Fel and the other starfighter pilots are for system support.  Incon losses gives me added forfeiture. Imp dom gives me a chance to retrieve my forfeited characters. All power gives the bombers added power (+2) and immunity to attrition. Brandei and short range fighters pulls ties to help put on dreaded or you can use SRF to retrieve lost force. Reactor term also give me an added boost from my hand cards at the end of a timed-out game. Presence is there to give a little bigger drain at a system, it helps, I've won and lost many games by one or two. Well that basically sums up my strategy, what do you think?

Thanks Shewski, i did all i could do to your advice (i only own 1 dread, dont have a def v of secret).
